eyebrow: The search space is a config file, not a guess
code:
method: bayes
metric:
  name: val_loss
  goal: minimize
parameters:
  learning_rate:
    distribution: log_uniform_values
    min: 0.00001
    max: 0.01
  batch_size:
    values: [16, 32, 64, 128]
  dropout:
    distribution: uniform
    min: 0.0
    max: 0.5
early_terminate:
  type: hyperband
  min_iter: 3
caption: Every parameter declares its own distribution -- log scale for learning rate, uniform for dropout.

eyebrow: Not everything belongs in the search space

steps.sub: layers, heads -- set from prior evidence, not swept

steps.sub: even Bayesian search loses efficiency past ~10-15 dims

code:
wandb sweep sweep.yaml --project my-project
wandb agent my-entity/my-project/<sweep-id>
caption: wandb sweep registers the search space; wandb agent is the worker that pulls configs and trains.
